text.en:
Sub-item (m), Group II, item 27 for the Province of Leyte, paragraph (a), Title C, section one of Republic Act Numbered Nine hundred twenty is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(m) Burauen-Albuera road ₱56,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
